utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good morning, Madam Registrar. Would you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is the case number IT-05-88-T, the Prosecutor versus Vujadin Popovic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. All the accused are present. Prosecution is Mr. McCloskey and Mr. Nicholls. From the Defence teams I notice the absence of Mr. Meek, Mr. Bourgon and Mr. Josse. All right. Any preliminaries? Yes, Mr. Nicholls?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to my friends. I think the only preliminary is that Mr. Blaszczyk we planned to have testify today regarding what we've called the road book, the locations on the Petrovic video. Two short preliminaries. One, I think my estimate was off. I said two hours of direct. I think it's going to take me quite a bit longer than that probably most of the day and I've told my friends that. And the second is that I believe we need the response to the 65 ter motion.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Obviously, I was coming to that actually first and foremost. What's the position, Mr. Lazarevic? I see he's interested in intervening.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, I will make a response on behalf of Mr. Borovcanin Defence. The Prosecution, in its motion dated 27th November 2007, requested five exhibits to be added to their 65 ter list.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: For three of these, our team or, rather, Mr. Borovcanin's Defence takes no position. These are reports pertaining to the location and procedure for seizure of a video. I will read the ERN numbers for the record. It's 0606-0071 for B/C/S version, and 0606-0073 in English. The next one is 0606-0070 in B/C/S and 0606-0072. It's a receipt for the temporary seizure of a video. The third one is V000-7149. It's a videotape of the Srebrenica events. It's more or less the same as the video we already have in the evidence. As for the first two exhibits proposed by the Prosecution, I will refer to the first one as road book. These are still frames from the Petrovic video and the other one is interactive road book CD, so I'll call it interactive CD. We oppose to the admission of these two documents or rather these two exhibits to Rule 65 Prosecution list for the following reasons. First of all, we believe that the probative value of these two evidence is not sufficient to justify the -- their admissibility to Rule 65 ter list of the Prosecution. These two exhibits were made recently by the Office of the Prosecutor so their probative value is a very relative one. These are not documents generated during the events covered by the indictment. These are Prosecution-made exhibits which were made very recently and for this reason, their probative value is not that high. On the other hand, we submit that these two exhibits are repetitive to other exhibits in this case. First, these are still frames from the Petrovic video. We have seen Petrovic video many times in this courtroom and I believe that we will also be able to see it on many other occasions, so I do believe that it's already contained in the evidence of this case. The Trial Chamber at the very beginning of this case was on site visit and, Your Honours were able to see all these locations, your attention was directed towards some specific places there, and thus I believe that Your Honours are very familiar with all these locations, with all these -- and furthermore, these two -- these two exhibits are repetitive to each other. They both contain same photographs and same still frames from the very same video, and I believe that the Prosecution has not shown good cause to admit it on to their 65 ter list.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So Mr. Lazarevic, can I take it that you are not challenging those photos are stills from that video?

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: By all means, Your Honour you are perfectly right. These are all still frames from that video and there is no doubt about it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Do you wish to comment, Mr. Nicholls?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes, briefly, Your Honour. I think my friend's really made two objections, one that this evidence would be cumulative and two that the probative value would be low, and Your Honours, I don't think either of those objections are a valid reason to reject this evidence out of hand before you've seen it and heard it. First of all, this exhibit, this demonstrative exhibit, was -- has been sometime in the making. It was begun in 2006 and we gave copies as we worked on it to the Defence and to Mr. Lazarevic so he could review it and we talked about it together and I haven't heard any objection as to the accuracy of the locations marked in this exhibit. What it is intended to do is to show Your Honours, when you see a still or a part of the Petrovic video, where that photo, where that portion of the film was actually taken and I think that will be very useful because watching the video, it is sometimes difficult to tell exactly where one is. Mr. Blaszczyk is a very experienced investigator on this case. He's been up and down that road. I'll proffer he'll testify many, many times. And he spent a long time working out on this video where different portions were taken and he used GPS technology to map it precisely and that's what we want to show you is where different portions of these videos were taken. And it's important because for a lot of this video which we'll learn from the next witness, Mr. Petrovic, Mr. Borovcanin was present in the vehicle while the video was being taken. I don't think the evidence is cumulative because true these are stills from the video but there were also stills taken of the same locations showing where we are because the video stills are sometimes -- sometimes parts of the video are blurry or it's difficult to tell exactly where one is. The exhibits, the book and the CD are not cumulative to each other because although they contain the same photos, the CD allows the person operating it to see left and right and up and down and move around and gives a much better perspective than just the flat photographic book can. It's true that Your Honours went on a site visit a long time ago at the beginning of this case and I think that's a good reason to admit this evidence, because it will allow Your Honours, I hope, to remember different places because we have more current photographs in here of the locations which Your Honours saw as well as the corresponding photos from the video which was taken in 1995. The other reason I think it's important to put this in in this format is Mr. Petrovic, who actually shot the video, based on his interview is unable to tell where all of these places were that he was shooting so we can't hear it all just from him. He said in his interview that he wasn't sure where some of these places are that he filmed, he wasn't that familiar with the area and he actually said in part of his interview that he went back recently and tried to figure out where he had been shooting different scenes and he couldn't do it. So I think this is the only way and the best way to provide you with an overview of that important piece of evidence, the video, and to show you the directions that were taken during the video, the precise places where we stopped, and later where different people are on the video at different times of the day on the 13th and the 14th of July. So I don't think it's cumulative. Of course, at the end after you've heard the evidence and at the end of the case when you weigh all the evidence you'll be able to assign it whatever probative value you think it deserves, but I don't think now is the time to reject it out of hand. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. I thank you. Thank you, Mr. Nicholls. Mr. Lazarevic, if you look at the Prosecution motion of the 27th November and precisely the part where the first of these five documents sought to be included in the 65 ter list is described, there is also a comment made there, namely that -- I'm going to read it: "A substantially similar rough draft of the road book was disclosed in the late 2006 and the Defence were told that an improved -- an improved version of the road book was being produced." I haven't heard you comment on this because I suppose it does carry some weight.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Well, because -- yes, Your Honour, I did not comment and that is true. I mean, the Prosecution did provide us with a copy of this draft material, not just one but on two or three occasions because this material was changed on quite a number of occasions. Last one that we received, and this is the one I believe that the Prosecution wishes to admit to their 65 ter list, we received on Friday afternoon if I'm not wrong. My colleague will tell more. There are some changes. I cannot say these are significant changes. I have to be fair to the Prosecution. These are not significant changes comparing to the previous draft, but they did provide us with this. However, what I'm suggesting is that some of these photographs containing this evidence are made last year, I think, and I don't see how can they assist the Trial Chamber. I mean, these are photographs of some, well, some houses, some meadows and things like that as they look now. These are not -- part of them are still frames from the video while the other part are photographs taken right now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you, Mr. Lazarevic. Does anyone else wish to comment on the Prosecution motion? Yes, Mr. Nicholls?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Could I just say, Your Honour, and I thank my friend for pointing it out the changes were very minor as we went along with this. They weren't new photos, new material; it was mainly reordering it to try to put it in a more logical manner using the same photos and changing some of the text underneath the photos, the explanations but it's the same book.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Any further comments? None. I need to confer with my colleagues.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: We are unanimous here in disagreeing with you, Mr. Lazarevic and agreeing totally with the submission of the Prosecution, that the inclusion of all these five documents, particularly the first two probably, of these five documents, are important for a better understanding of the video that eventually we will be seeing. So they are -- the Prosecution request is being acceded to, and these will be included in the 65 ter list. As to probative value, the important sense of the word, as you put it, Mr. Nicholls, this is ultimately a matter that will have to be tended to, addressed, by the Trial Chamber at the appropriate time and not now. Thank you. All right. Can we bring in Mr. Blaszczyk? Or something else? One moment, Madam Usher.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Sorry, Your Honour, just the last three exhibits, I don't want to speak for my friend but I believe at this point there is no objection to the documents.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: No, no. What we were admitting is the five of them, not just the two.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Sorry.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: As far as the last three are concerned, we noted that Mr. Lazarevic took no position.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Judge Kwon anticipated what I was going to come to. Mr. Ostojic and Mr. Nicholls, Mr. Ostojic hadn't finished his cross-examination, and I took this motion to mean that this will come up during re-examination.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Or is it going to be further testimony? I don't see it as a further testimony.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: In other words, do you plan to have Mr. Blaszczyk finish the previous testimony on that chapter and then summon him again on this new chapter or were you going to deal with this matter during re-examination?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: What -- I spoke to my friend about this yesterday, Your Honour. What I intended to do, if it pleases the Trial Chamber is now start with the road book and finish the road book hopefully today and then when we have time at the end, Mr. Ostojic would finish his cross-examination on the Drina Corps and any re-examination would take place after we conclude this chapter.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Agreed, Mr. Ostojic? Because this concerns you more than anyone else for the time being.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. If it's acceptable to you I could work with that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: For us it's neither fish nor fowl.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Nor for me, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So we are not having breakfast this morning. Good morning, Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, good morning, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. We are going to open a new chapter today in your testimony, as you are most probably or definitely aware but then at some later point in time during the day we'll return to the Drina Corps collection recovery, where Mr. Ostojic has still got to finish his cross-examination. So I think for this purpose, I need to administer the oath again to you. Madam Usher.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I solemnly declare that I will speak the truth, the whole truth and nothing but the truth.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, sir. Please make yourself comfortable. Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Good morning.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Good morning, sir.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Their Honours have been passed out copies of the book you made, 65 ter 2986. Mr. Blaszczyk, could you please briefly, very briefly, describe what this book is and the -- what it shows us?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Your Honours, in February 2006, the witness Zoran Petrovic was interviewed and during this interview he made available this raw material he had recorded in Srebrenica area in July 1995. We made a copy of this raw material for our purpose and then from the copied material, we got the stills from this copied materials, we collected the stills in this road book and also we found a location where the stills were -- where the footage was recorded and we made our own pictures and also we attached to this book for comparison purposes of course.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. And can you just briefly tell us the different versions of the Petrovic video that we have that are relevant to this book?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We received a few version of the Petrovic video. We received a Petrovic video, I mean the copy of the Petrovic video from BBC in 2002 and we received in fact we copied raw material, Petrovic video, from him during his interview in 2006, in February 2006, and also we have a copy of Petrovic video which was handed over to us by the Ministry of Defence, Bosnia-Herzegovina, in 2007.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And could you just tell the Trial Chamber about the Studio B footage, what we call the Studio B footage of the Petrovic video?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The Studio B footage of the Petrovic video, this is -- it was broadcasted by the Serbian television in 1995, I believe it was July 1995, and consists of the material which had been recorded by Mr. Petrovic during his visit in Srebrenica area in July 1995, and we received a copy of this broadcast from Studio B from Mr. Borovcanin during his interview in 2002. He handed over this copy to us. And also, during the interview with Mr. Petrovic, Zoran Petrovic, we received also a copy of the same broadcast.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And just to be clear, the Studio B footage is different because it was edited material for broadcast, it's not exactly the same as the raw material; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, you are right. This is not exactly the same material. It was edited material in the studio but consists, of course, the footage from Petrovic, the raw material from the Petrovic video.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I'd like to show you quickly a couple of documents, the first one is 2988. This is the 26th of June -- 22nd of June, excuse me, 1996, report on television footage from Srebrenica, a Main Staff document. Can you just tell us what this document is? I think you'd already referred to it.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is report on television footage from Srebrenica signed by the Colonel Milovan Milutinovic regarding the raw material recorded by Zoran Petrovic, Pirocanac during operation in Srebrenica in July 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: How to [indiscernible] this raw material.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Could you just tell us again when did we receive this document in the OTP?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The first time, in fact, OTP team had access to the archive of army to the Ministry of Defence, Ministry of Defence Bosnia and Herzegovina in Banja Luka in October of 2006, and during this -- these meetings, you know, during this access to the archive, they located and they scanned this document and when we received the scanned document here in The Hague we requested the Ministry of Defence to send us the original copy of this document.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And we received the original, the copy, the original document in, I believe it was January 2007.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, if we could have 2989, please?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Mr. Nicholls, perhaps it's better to clarify this now rather than later, if the witness can explain it. The name of Zoran Petrovic, as we know him here, is Zoran Pirocanac and the witness also mentioned both surnames, family names, Zoran Petrovic, Pirocanac. If you could explain what the position is?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Could you please explain --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Whether he's Petrovic, whether he's both, whether he's just Pirocanac.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes, please explain.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Zoran Petrovic also use the nickname of Pirocanac or name of Pirocanac. And he -- mostly he was both names, Petrovic, Pirocanac.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Just while we are on this document, who is this who signed it, Colonel Milutinovic?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Colonel Milutinovic was the head of information department from the Main Staff of army of Republika Srpska.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, if we could go to 2989, please. This is dated 24th of June 1996 and it's a receipt for a videotape. Just tell us very simply what this document is.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is also receipt for temporarily seized object regarding the same tape which had mentioned in the previous document and we received first the copy of this document along with a copy of the previous document and later on, we received the original of these documents. The document has been signed, I believe, by Ljubisa Beara.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. I'm through with those two. Now, I'd like you to explain a little bit more before we start going through the book, how you actually took the photos which were taken, the contemporary photos, up and down the road and matched them to the stills from the Petrovic video. What did you actually do to make sure you were getting photos of the correct locations?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. Before I went on mission in -- to Bosnia-Herzegovina to locate all these places, Petrovic video, we printed out the stills from the Petrovic video, we took with us also the copy of high quality recordings of Petrovic video, together with portable recorder, player, with us, and we went to the places where the video had been recorded by Petrovic. And when we were on the places, on this area of Srebrenica, Potocari, Sandici, Lolici, Pervani, we were driving in the same road which was used by Mr. Pirocanac/Petrovic and Mr. Borovcanin and we stopped all these places. We compared the surrounding topographics with the stills we had printed and with the video we had with us, and also we compare the area which was located by us with the surrounding houses, with the curve, with the made-up of the roads on the spot.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. And besides this mission where were you putting together photos for the road book, how familiar are you with those roads in Srebrenica and Potocari, Kravica, Zeleni Jadar? How many times have you been in this area yourself?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can say I'm very familiar with this area. I've been there many times, I don't know exactly how many but about 40, 50 probably.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And if you could just tell us briefly who else was on that mission with you.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Together with me on mission went also Zoran Lasic, our video assistant and who made the copy of raw material of Petrovic and who was also involved in this project, and in one day I believe Mr. Nicholls also attended this trip.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. And can you just tell us, and we are nearly done with this part, about how you used a GPS device while you were locating the different places?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: When we spotted the location which was depicted in Petrovic stills we took the photos of these locations and also we recorded the GPS readings of this particular location and we used, in fact we used two GPS devices because we wanted to be sure that the readings is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I believe Your Honours have a copy of the book now. Do you have your copy?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could just look at this now.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Your Honours, what I plan to do soon is watch the video and stop it at appropriate places and have the witness explain how the photos and the stills are related to the newer photos. That will be done in Sanction and we'll have the transcript of the video as we follow. So I think it's best to use the hard copies of the book rather than to try to switch back and forth from e-court because each time we have to get out of Sanction and then try to find where we were again in the film so if that's all right.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: And I think it will educate us better because later on that's how we'll have to do it in any case.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honours, thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, briefly, Mr. Blaszczyk, could you just explain, it's pretty self explanatory, we've got maps on the first five pages. Can you just tell us what those maps show?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the first pages we attached the three maps of Bosnia-Herzegovina and the detailed maps of the area where the Petrovic video had been recorded, the maps were created in BIC [sic] unit here in The Hague by its officer and also we attached satellite image of the same area.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, it says, in the transcript, BIC unit. I think it's GIS unit. Can you tell us very quickly what that is, GIS?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of course, this is GIS unit, this is geographical information system unit.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, if we can just go to pages 6 and 7, this is chapter 1, Potocari. And again, quite self explanatory but can you just tell us what these numbered positions refer to on page 7 on the map?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a map of -- NATO map for Bosnia-Herzegovina, and on the map also with the help with the assistance of GIS unit, I plotted the location using the GPS readings we taken in our mission in May in Bosnia-Herzegovina in these locations.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And I would like to say that this is chapter 1, and for each chapter --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Let's proceed. Sorry for the interruption but we needed to discuss something.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If you could continue, Mr. Blaszczyk, you were just saying for each chapter and then you stopped. You had something to say.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think I should say that I divided this book for five chapters, and each chapter started from the map, detailed map, of the particular area where the footage was recorded by Mr. Petrovic, Pirocanac.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. And if we could turn to pages 8 and 9, just so that we all understand the way the book is set up, can you -- on the left we've got the Petrovic video still, on the right we've got a photo taken in June by you and the video assistant. Could you please explain the information on these pages and the way you've set it up?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: In each chapter, after the map, detailed map of the area, the particular area, the map is followed by the page with the still or stills from the Petrovic video, and these pages with the stills of the Petrovic video is also followed by the recent picture -- recent picture -- the picture made by us during our mission in Bosnia-Herzegovina, the picture of the same area which was depicted in the previous page.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And the counter underneath the photo on the Petrovic video, that is from the original -- the copy of his original raw footage in the high 8 format, is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. You are right. We used the counter of the digital recorder device we used to copy the raw material from Petrovic and below also I attached the information, the location where the stills was taken and the position on the map, on the previous map of the same location which is depicted on this picture or pictures.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And here we've got 0:00:37:13 and is it right this that this means we are at 37 seconds and actually at frame 13 of that 37th second? In other words, it's not -- that is the last two digits refer to the actual frame that was used on the videotape?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, you are right. This is the counter from the digital recorder device.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, Your Honours, I should say that nearly every time this is played on a different player, whether it's in a CD or electronic, the counter may be a little bit different. When we loaded the entire video, the same video, into Sanction, unfortunately, it's about exactly four seconds ahead when you play it in Sanction. This is the most precise numbering, which is on the tape which we'll be putting into evidence but the exact still will -- may be about four seconds off if you're playing it in Sanction. And I think now, Ms. Stewart, if we could start playing the video which is 65 ter 2054, Your Honours. This is the copy made during the interview of Mr. Petrovic, the copy of his raw material which he brought to the video. And if we could -- stop at 41, 8.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I think we went past it. If we could stop and just go back a bit. That's -- forward a bit. Okay. That's close. We are at 36.9.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: What is the building here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is Dutch UNPROFOR base in Potocari, but it's not exactly the same picture as we had on the page 8 of this road book but it's very similar. We are coming to this picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: That's fine. It's 41.9?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And this is heading in the direction now --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The car and the cameraman is reading to the direction of Srebrenica. And on the page 8 we have the same still, we can see almost the same still we can see on the screen. And on the right side, on the page number 9, we have the picture taken by me and Zoran Lasic during our mission and depict also the same -- the same building.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And what is the date that this video was taken?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The video was taken on the 13 of July, 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Your Honours, this will speed up a bit. There is more detail in the beginning in Potocari and we won't be going through every page at this same pace.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. We are at 53.8. Could you just tell us what we see here on page 10 of the book and we are at picture A.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We see the group of the people marching towards Bratunac, in direction of Srebrenica, and this still was also recorded on the 13th of July 1995 by Zoran Petrovic as another stills from the same location in Potocari.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could continue to about 102?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. We went -- we are now at about picture B on page 10. Could you tell us why you selected that one and labelled the Feros building in the picture?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I selected this picture because in the background we can see the building who is very recognisable, you know, from the spot, on the spot, when you are in Potocari you can see this building. It's still in the same shape. We called it Feros building. And we can see that people walking also from direction of Srebrenica towards Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We'll play a little bit more.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I think if you want to refer to what's in page C, you need to go back but I don't know -- I don't know whether you intended to skip it purposely.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I was going to skip that one, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Then I misunderstood you before. Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now we've stopped at picture D and we've just gone through picture C, we can see the sequence on the counters. Can you just tell us why you selected this photo we see on page 10, photo D, from the original stills?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, these two photos are selected from this part of the video we just played and it showed a group of the people walking from Srebrenica direction towards Bratunac on the left side of the road looking towards Srebrenica. It's also locations Potocari, also Dutch UNPROFOR base.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And now, just as we are beginning to see how you set up the book, can you show us on page 11 why you selected these photos and labelled them and how you came to the conclusion that where we have A, B, C and D on page 11, the markings in photo 3, that these correspond to the photos A, B, C and D on page 10?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the page 11 I put the picture of -- taken along the road from former Dutch UNPROFOR base and the Feros building. And on the picture 2 and on picture 3 we can see the Feros building which is also depicted on the stills from Petrovic book, on the picture, on the still B, from the page 10.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And so we can see, then, just if I understand you, that where these photos, where this bit of video was taken was really directly in front of and passing by the Feros building towards Bratunac?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, you're correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could continue playing now.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. We are now at approximately the photo A on page 12. Can you just tell us -- and we see there witness van Duijn speaking. Can you tell us where we are in these series of photos on page 12 and 13?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: In this photo, we are in the Dutch APC check-point. It was located -- this check-point was located about 50 metres north of the express bus compound in Potocari, and almost in the front of the blue building.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. If we could continue now.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. We are right now at about photo B on page 12 and we can see the hill in the background. Again, can you tell us how you were able to tell where this spot was?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: With the same location what was the previous still, this is in Potocari, about 50 metres from the bus compound in Potocari, north from -- of the express bus compound and the hills in the background are the same hills which are depicted on the page 13 on my photos from 2006. And when we played this part of the video, we could also notice the buildings of Zinc Factory in Potocari, and part of the bus compound.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Play, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, approximately at the last photo on page 12, photo D, we see the woman walking towards Bratunac and the two UN APCs. Can you just tell us about this concrete strip which we see on the right side of the photo coming up to the UPC on the right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a small bridge which is crossing the creek, the creek who is passing the road from Budak area towards Potocari, to the left side.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And where is that part of the little bridge over the drainage creek, where would that be on the photo on page 13?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is exactly on the right side, actually in the middle of this photo, in the bottom of the middle of this photo we see the small bridge.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Finally, that building on the left we see on page 13, can you tell us about that building, the big white and brown brick building behind the fence?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is quite new building. It was built after the war in Bosnia-Herzegovina, after 1995, I believe after 2000, 2003. And in the background we can see also on this picture from page 13 the Zinc Factory and Energoinvest factory and part of the bus on the left side behind the new building, the part of the bus compound in Potocari.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. If we could now play for a while and go to page 14 and 15.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. We stopped at 7.27 on the Sanction, just a little bit past the photo F on page 14, and you've got this location labelled as the blue building and its yard opposite the Feros building. Can you just tell us about these two pages, pages 14 and 15 of the book, where we are in the video sequence we've just seen?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: The stills from the page 14 were taken from the part of the video we had played just recently, right now. And it was recorded on -- in the yard of the blue building which is located in opposite of Feros building on the road in Potocari and about, from this Feros building, distance to the white house which is also located across from the DutchBat is about 100 metres towards Bratunac. And on the page 15, I made -- we made the recent picture of the same area, I think it's very visible here that it's the same building, the blue building and its surroundings and on the page, the page 15, on the picture 4, I made a picture also of remains of the fence which we can see on few stills from the page 14, on still B, still E or still F. And the white house in relation to this blue building is located about 100 metres towards Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Let's continue, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. We are on pages 16 and 17, now stopped at approximately picture A on page 16 and we just noticed from the camera scenes that the cameraman, Zoran Petrovic, was walking with his camera and the camera was filming the ground as he walked. Where are we now?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Right now we are in the front of outside of the white house in Potocari.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And again, approximately -- this is -- you said about approximately how long -- how far away is this from the blue building?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: A very short distance. We could see how the cameraman left the yard of the blue building and walked towards white house. He recorded a group of the people in front of the white house. It was about 100, 150 metres.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. If we could just play now some more, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We are now at just about, we've continued and we are now at picture D on 16 -- excuse me, picture B. What do we see here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We see the gate of the white house and the pile of the belongings in front of the gate.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could continue playing, please?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: See the same group of the people which had been recorded on the picture A from page 16.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And then just as we've seen the camera pan this group of people with Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Kingori are just in the road near the belongings; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: This is page 16, picture C. Continue, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Stop. Thanks. Can we go to that? Stop here.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We are now at approximately picture 16 D and we will get to it and we saw that the next frame is a picture of a large shell. Can you just tell us what's happened here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is -- we see again the picture of the gate of the white house located in Potocari, and when we have the frame of the white house gate and the belongings in front of the white house, we got the picture of the big shell. This is not recorded in Potocari, this frame but according to the witness Petrovic it was recorded over later on probably at his house.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And have you ever seen that shell yourself?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I seen the shell by myself when I went together with witness Petrovic to his house in Belgrade to collect his raw material from his house, he showed me the shell on his balcony. It's the same shell. Looks the same and probably is the same one.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Did he say it was the same or is that your conclusion from looking at it?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: He -- he told me that this is the same shell and what he's recorded on his raw material.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Now, if we could look at -- this is quite self explanatory but page 17 you've got B and D and A and C marked. This shows the locations of the group of people in A and C as well as the pile of belongings; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. On the page 17, on the picture number 1, we see I marked with B and D the location of the stills from the page 16 B and D, and A, C, the location of the group of the people which are depicted on the stills A, C, from page 16. And the second picture, this is a picture taken from the position of A, C.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. You're talking about picture 2?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: So if you're at position A, C, where Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Kingori are, you can look across the road at the Feros building; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's correct. When we look across, this is the Feros building and we see part of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. I'd like to now play a different clip. This is from Studio B.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Your Honours, this is the Studio B footage. It's actually taken from our trial video because there it's got the captioning already. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And I should say that was 65 ter 2011, the Studio B footage which contains the close-up of the men on the balcony.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, can you just tell us about the comparison clip before we watch it that was put together of the raw material, which we received from Mr. Petrovic, which contains the shell, compared to the Studio B material, broadcast in Belgrade on 17 July 1995, which shows zoom up to the men on the balcony.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. We compared the raw material we received, we copied, from Mr. Petrovic, and the Studio B broadcast material we received from Mr. Borovcanin, and we played both of the clips together and we could see that the clips are fit to each other and except the part where we see on the raw material, the copied raw material, the shell from the balcony of Mr. Borovcanin [sic] which was recorded over at later stage.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Before we play that, could we just look at pages 18 and 19 of the book?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the --

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And just very simply --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Lazarevic?

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: I could be wrong but here in the transcript we do have on page 27, line 5 and 6, the shell from the balcony of Mr. Borovcanin. I don't know whether I understood this properly but I don't remember Mr. Borovcanin having any shells on his balcony.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, of course this is the shell from the balcony of Mr. Pirocanac, Petrovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Lazarevic, and Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, I think it's quite obvious but just to be clear, on pages 18 and 19, we've got pictures of the men crowded on the balcony. This is the first time in the book on the left-hand side where we've got images not from the Petrovic video which he gave us but from the Studio B and it's got the logo there; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, this is correct. We attached on this page, on page 18, the stills from the Studio B broadcast which are not visible on the raw material handed over to us by Mr. Petrovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, what I'd like to do, Your Honours, is play 2991, which is a split-screen showing the two segments together.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And on the right-hand side is the Petrovic video. On the left will be the Studio B.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: On these two clips, on the right side we have the clip from Petrovic raw material and on the left side we have Studio B broadcast clip and we can compare how these two clips are fit to each other.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And other than about a one or two second gap, they come back to the same footage at the end after the --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: That ends chapter 1. Your Honours, what I'd like to do now, if I may, is --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I don't know if I'm reading your mind. Are you thinking of having the break now and continuing immediately after or starting and having the break regularly.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: No, Your Honours I wanted now Mr. Blaszczyk to show the way the CD part of Potocari works. The CD only has two sections Potocari and the road, it doesn't have all the parts of the --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: So if you can hopefully this will work. We tried it on Friday. Mr. Blaszczyk should be able to operate it from the laptop. And can you just talk us through the way this works when you use the controls at first?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. Maybe I will tell that to this road book I attached also the CD with presentation, with multi-media presentation of two chapters of this road book, and we are using the computer software to play this CD, and this is media quick player, QuickTime player, sorry, and we can use this button, the button on the bottom, to control of this presentation. The first button to the right, this is information button. Pressing this button, we can mark all the area which is link to another picture or stills. This is button marked with plus, we can zoom in -- I'm sorry, we can zoom in -- we can zoom in the present picture, if you want. This is zoom out. And the button on the left, we can go to the previous page.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And pressing the right button of mouse, we see the map of Bosnia-Herzegovina with the marked area of Bratunac and Srebrenica. We can also use this information button to see if everything is marked here correctly. Pressing on this field, the link, we are coming to the map closer to more detailed map of this area, come in again we have again more detailed map of Bratunac area divided with two rectangles of Potocari and also Sandici and Kravica area. We can go in and we have detailed map of the area of Potocari. All these circles here with sign, we can see pressing the button on the right and link to another view, another picture or stills.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Can you just -- these are the same still photos that we have in the book. Can you just show us what you've included here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. This presentation includes the same stills from Petrovic video we use in the road book and the pictures we made in our mission in this area in 2006. And we can, with this software, we can easily move through these pictures and to have better view or better understanding of the area where the --

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. If you could go through and just show us what you've included in here perhaps in the same order that we've just -- that you've included it in chapter 1?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay. We start with the same order. Okay. We are in front of the white house right -- I'm sorry, in front on the white house, we have overview of this area. I'm heading towards direction of Bratunac. We see the Dutch base compound in front of us. We are moving slowly towards direction of Srebrenica. We are passing the Feros building which is located across the road from white house. This road heading to Srebrenica. Here we have link to another picture, extending picture, you know, from the blue -- in the front of the blue building towards Srebrenica. On this -- on this picture, we marked the links to the stills from Petrovic video and we located the place where the stills were taken. This group of people are walking towards Srebrenica, towards, sorry, Bratunac, from Srebrenica direction, and they on the road between blue building and white house. We have the group on the left side of the road, the same road. We can see the group of the people walking from direction of Srebrenica towards Bratunac. This is also in the same area. This is the blue building and white house. In front we see -- in front of us we see the building of Feros company. We can press the link to the picture from the stills from Petrovic video. We can see in the background the same building. This picture was taken from the front of the white house. Now, this link take us to the picture of the white house.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And if we could go to this link you've got here on the road just by the white house.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. We can press the link here. We see the picture, we see the still from the Petrovic video, the group of the people including Mr. Borovcanin and Major Kingori. This link take us to the still from Petrovic video as well, in front of the gate. And we are coming to the balcony of the white house. As I said at the beginning, we can use these buttons in the bottom to zoom in and move closer.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Are there any other links of Potocari you wanted to show?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. We are in the yard of the blue building. We see the location of the blue building in relation to the DutchBat, behind the Feros building. And this link can take us to the still from the Petrovic video. We can compare the blue building from this still and the blue building from our recent picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I think that's a good time, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: We'll have a 25-minute break. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: We are at page 20, if we are going back to the road book.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk, I think we've pretty much covered maybe not every single link but pretty much covered the Potocari portion of the CD; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Just before we leave Potocari and move on, if I could -- I'd just like to show one overview to remind us where the area we've been looking at is. If I could have 65 ter 1517, this was not on my exhibit list for Mr. Blaszczyk. I e-mailed my friends last night that I might be using this aerial. While it's loading, Mr. Blaszczyk, this is an aerial image of Potocari dated 13 July. Thank you. And without going over it again, can you just show us, we see here we've got marked the Feros building which you pointed out to us and the white house, the Zinc Factory and the UN base and you've explained how the filming began heading towards Srebrenica passing the UN base. Can you just indicate, it's not marked on here, where the blue building is and the -- just the area where we -- of the video we have been seeing and the pictures we have been seeing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: It's already all marked. I don't know why you are asking to mark it again.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: No, just if he -- it was only the blue building I didn't see marked, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Oh, I see. Okay.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is the blue building.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. You've made a red X over the blue building and just if you can tell us approximately how far Mr. Petrovic, based on the video we saw and the stills, how far toward Srebrenica we got before the film stopped at the white house?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Petrovic, he stopped his car, I mean Mr. Borovcanin together with Mr. Petrovic, they stopped the car on the way between the white house and the blue building, a distance of about 100, 150 metres.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. Next to that X that he's marked, could you -- could he write blue building or BB?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, I think this covers the area.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Could you just please --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Lazarevic?

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Well, I would just like if my colleague could handle this, I believe that Mr. Blaszczyk is now starting giving evidence about where Mr. Petrovic and Mr. Borovcanin were stopping their cars and things like that. I would like to avoid this kind of evidence with this witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I think it's pretty clear from the video where the car stops and where we see the camera outside. We don't know the exact parking spot. I'm not presenting exactly where it was. I think it's fine that Mr. Blaszczyk just stated it's in the vicinity between the blue building and the white house based on his viewing of the video and his knowledge of the area.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: It's not precise exactly where the car stopped, just gave an indication of an area. And in any case, you can deal with that on cross-examination, if you wish so, Mr. Lazarevic. No big deal. Yes, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, I'm done with that. We could mark it, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If could you sign and date it, Mr. Blaszczyk?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. I've finished with that.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, if we could just look at page 21 of the book, quite self explanatory but here we have got marked the locations of the stills in this chapter which you've titled on the road Sandici, Pervani, Kravica; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, if we could go to pages 22 and 23, please, which you've called a panorama of Sandici meadow, it's surroundings and the area. These are clearly not from the Petrovic video. Could you just explain what you've done here very quickly?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I would like to show the Sandici area and its surroundings, it's quite complicated for people who have been there only once or never before. And I would like to show the location of the particular objects I will refer to in future, like the destroyed house in Sandici meadow, like the destroyed white house opposite Sandici meadow, and Sandici meadow itself.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, if we could turn to pages 24 and 25, and we can start watching the video which will start shortly.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Slightly blurry on this frame but we stopped at page 24, the only picture on that page. Maybe we can get it slightly sharper. No. It's sharper when it plays. Can you tell us where we are here on Sandici meadow, Mr. Blaszczyk?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are exactly on Sandici meadow, this still was taken at Sandici meadow, in the background we see the house which is located in Sandici meadow. I made a picture of the same location on the page the picture is marked as the picture 1 on the page 25, we see the same building, destroyed house. In the picture, from the page 25, and the still from 24, and behind we see the same fields.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. And was that house -- we can see it's in fairly similar condition still as it was in -- on July 13th, 1995?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And could we now go to pages 26 and 27? And just to be clear, Mr. Blaszczyk, could you explain how the picture of the man calling out on page 26, we see him in A, B and C, these are not in exact sequence as we'll see them on the video, but you've grouped them together here; is that right? Could you explain that?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I did it because in the meantime, the cameraman Zoran Petrovic who recorded this footage, he pointed camera on this man calling other people from the wood and he moved camera to another object and again he came back to the same object, to the same man.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. If we could play now?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Again, we stopped at just about picture C on page 26 and you've marked on page 27 in picture 1 where these photos are from. This is just about in the middle of Sandici meadow; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, this is correct and also I made the picture from Sandici meadow in the direction of the destroyed white house showing the distance between the Sandici meadow, the location I spotted, and destroyed white house across the road from Sandici meadow, and also I marked the direction Kravica and Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, if we could look at pages 28 and pages 29 of the book, we see here pictures of the armoured vehicles on page 28, a truck which we had gone past just a moment ago. And I notice that on page 29, you have not marked the location of the tank, I'll call it, we see in page 28 D. Why is that not marked on page 29?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I didn't mark the location of the tank from the still from the still D, and the truck from still C from the page 28 because I wasn't sure which place these two vehicles were located at that time. I saw the picture, I know that this is in Sandici meadow, I couldn't locate the place, the exact place.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Now, if we could continue playing?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Just while it's playing there is a blank spot here and some voiceover. Can you tell us what's happening here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is recorded over part of the Petrovic raw material. We can hear the voice of Mr. Petrovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could back up a tiny bit, please? Okay. Stop. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We now have gone past photo A and we are at photo B on page 30, Mr. Borovcanin talking to the two uniformed men and actually we see the date stamp now of 13 July 1995 and the time stamp. That's on the original raw material from Mr. Petrovic. If we look on page 31, you've labelled and marked where this scene is taking place. Can you just explain how you arrived at that conclusion and then we'll watch the next sequence where the camera sweeps.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I mark the location of these two men and Mr. Borovcanin, watching the video, Petrovic video, very carefully on the spot in Sandici meadow in this location. And in this picture, in this particular picture, which is also the still which is also the picture here, the still B on page 13 on the left corner, top of the corner, you see the part -- probably the part of destroyed white house. And later on, please notice when the cameraman is moving the camera, directing the camera from two men and Mr. Borovcanin to the Sandici meadow you will see that the camera is passing the road and showing us the location of Sandici meadow. And based on this one I just located this place.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And just so we know, how, in your mind, how precise is this location on page 31 where you've marked A and B where Mr. Borovcanin is at this moment of the film?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I believe this is precise. I can be mistaken by one, two metres, maybe three metres, but no more.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Now if we could play the film and watch the camera sweep over the road to the meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Back one frame. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. We saw the camera cross the road now to the meadow and that is we are now looking at page 32 of the book, photos A, B and C shows the camera zooming in at the group of men sitting down in the meadow with some armed men around them. And I should say, Your Honours, there is a typo in the counter for photo B. It says 11.54.10 and I believe we noticed yesterday when we were viewing that should be 44. Page 33, you've marked the location of these men sitting on the ground with the armed men around them. Can you just tell us about how you came to that conclusion?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Watching the video, the footage of Petrovic footage I noticed in Sandici, above the Sandici meadow, the small house is also visible, the small house on the still A from the page 32 above the Sandici meadow and I noticed it's the same house when I was over there in Sandici meadow in 2006.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, the photo taken on page 33, I can see that it's a compilation but when those photos were taken, where was the person taking the photograph standing? What's behind his back?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a compilation done by our video assistant Zoran Lasic who made a lot of photos on this area, compiled the photos in one panorama view.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: This is taken from across the road, where the white house is facing towards --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, the picture is taken from across the road exactly in the front of the destroyed white house across the road from Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. If we could go now to pages 34 and 35 and play the tape, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. This is close to approximately 34 C, picture 34 C. We've seen the shooting and the moving of these vehicles as they fire into the hills. Can you tell us how you just were able to tell which direction the -- these army vehicles were moving and army or MUP vehicles were moving and where they were on the road which you've marked on page 35?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As we see on the picture C, from the page -- of the still C from the page 34, the armed vehicles are moving towards Konjevic Polje. I located this place. This place is in Pervani, it's approximately about 2800 metres from Sandici meadow on the road leading towards Konjevic Polje, and I located, I spotted this place, you know, through the topographic features, like the hills in the background and made up of the roads.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. And that road between Sandici meadow and Konjevic Polje, it's got various parts which are curved and straight and some banked walls. Did you use any of those features?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes. Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. So then again, we've now, Mr. Petrovic and Mr. Borovcanin have left Sandici and are heading towards Konjevic Polje when we get to this portion of the video.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Watching the video, we see that Mr. Borovcanin together with Mr. Petrovic left the Sandici and they were heading Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. If we could continue to play, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Can I stop for one second?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We could hear some music from the video there playing. It's not very clear. It's clearer when you play the video by itself. Can you tell us where that music was coming from, if you know, if you found that out?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This music is coming from -- probably from the car of Mr. Borovcanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. If we can continue, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. The sequence we just saw of several minutes, were on pages 36 and 37 of the book, we saw the houses in A, B and C on page 36, and the firing on -- excuse me, photo D. And then you've identified several houses on page 37 and marked which ones they are. And also marked where we are on the road. Now, 3100 metres from Sandici meadow, still heading towards Konjevic Polje. Can you just explain how you were able to match up this area?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We moved a little bit further down along the road to Konjevic Polje and 300 metres, about 300 metres from the previous location, we spotted the houses which were depicted on Petrovic stills, and we see these houses on page 36 on the stills A, B and C. We located these houses and we came to conclusion that from the video that these two APC, two armed vehicles were parked next to these houses on the road leading towards Konjevic Polje. It's also Pervani area.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Just very briefly, we can see that the house in photo A on page 36 and the house in photo A on 37, there's been some restoration work going on. How are you able to tell that these were the same houses?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We can compare the pictures, the stills from 1995 and the pictures done in 2006 and we can see the same features like the windows, like the doors of the house.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And did you also --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Very similar. Of course, it was renovated after that but it is visible it is the same house.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Did you also look at the position of these houses relative to each other along the road?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, of course, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now we will be going to the next two pages, 38 and 39 and we'll play the video and catch up to here. Before we play it, on page 38 we see two houses which you've labelled as damaged -- and which you've labelled as a damaged house, the second one and the location now is 2.000 metres from Sandici meadow on the road leading from Konjevic Polje towards Sandici and Bratunac. So now, if I'm right, at this point, Mr. Petrovic is heading back, he's made a U-turn, he's heading back from the direction of Konjevic Polje towards Sandici meadow; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, you are correct. This is the first footage when -- on Petrovic video when we see that Mr. Petrovic is coming back to Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Lazarevic?

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: I'll have to object. This is leading question. I mean obviously at this point, Mr. Petrovic is heading back, he's made a U-turn, this kind of -- this is basically my colleague giving evidence. I would like him to avoid this kind of question with the witness.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: He made that conclusion. He can ask him.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: It was leading. If there is an objection, I'll stop. I was just trying to move it along. It's written here and so it's clear.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: But you've got the message from Mr. Lazarevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I've got the message, Your Honours. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Before we play the clip, could you please explain the direction we are going in, we've talked about it but how you concluded that?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We see from the later clips that Mr. Borovcanin -- Mr. Petrovic is heading towards Sandici meadow and on this area we spotted the house which is very similar to the house from this clip depicted on the -- on stills A and B from the page 38. The previous houses was already rebuilt after the war is -- has totally different shape but this house which we found is almost the same which we see on the stills on A and B, I mean the match house from picture 1 and 2 from page 39 and also the curve of the road is very similar to the curve. It's the same as on the picture B and A on the page 38.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And were you able, from looking at the video, to determine where, what portion of the road, Mr. Petrovic and Mr. Borovcanin made their U-turn or were you not able to figure that out exactly?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I wasn't able in which point they turn around because as we see it this place is located about 1.000 metres from the previous location and we had the previous clips with armoured vehicles.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: But this is the first footage recorded by Mr. Petrovic on the way back to Sandici meadow after the footage we see in -- with armed vehicles.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. If we could play the video now, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And then we can move on but this is the same section you've captured on page 38; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is correct, the same two houses.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. We can continue now in the same direction and look at pages 40 and 41, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. It came back quite quickly and we are on page 40 now. We just passed the man standing against the retaining wall in photo A of page 40 and we are now seeing the second man in military uniform in photo B of page 40. Could you tell us where this location is and how you determined the location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This location is located in Lolici area. This is about 900 metres from Sandici meadow on the road leading from Konjevic Polje towards Sandici and Bratunac. I managed to locate this road by passing this road several times and also I know that on this road on the left side of the road we have two retaining walls. The first one is in the Lolici area and another one is about few hundred metres before we reach Sandici meadow on the left side also and we can see that this is the wall from Lolici area.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Continue, if you have --

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, and of course, I compare also topography, topographic view of the surrounding hills.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. If we could continue playing the video and we would be on pages 42 and 43 now.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Now, this sequence still heading towards Sandici, we saw several men without stopping all the way along, we saw the man in photo A, flashing past the camera on page 42. If we look at photo B, on page 42, we can see there were two men there crouching behind the barrier looking towards the woods. The fourth man we see in this sequence is in photo C of 42 also crouching by the barrier. If I'm correct about this, Mr. Blaszczyk. And then it's difficult to see and it's difficult to see on the video but right where we stopped on photo D of page 42, how many or what is that up towards the -- just standing in front of the house we see ahead on the road?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: When you watch very carefully this part of the video you can see that we can see two men standing behind the barrier in front of the car heading towards Sandici and Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, I won't ask you any leading questions. Can you explain how you have marked the locations of photos A, B, C and D as you have on photos 1 and 2 on page 43? You've got a straight-on shot and you've got an overview. If could you explain that to us first.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I drove the same road which was used by Mr. Petrovic and Mr. Borovcanin, and I passed the same barriers on the right side of the road leading to Sandici meadow. It was just before the Sandici meadow, about 400 metres from Sandici meadow, and I compare the video clip and the stills from the video, this video, the Petrovic video, with the features on the road and I marked the location, quite a few locations of these men depicted on the page 42.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, on page 43, we see on the left side we don't see it on the video but we see a retaining wall. Is that the second retaining wall were you discussing a moment ago?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah. This is correct. This is the second retaining wall. The first one is Lolici and then we are coming to another one, last one before the Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. And -- continue.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And in the corner of the picture 1 from the page 43, I attach also the overview of the area and I marked a few locations in this picture, these overview pictures, Sandici -- like Sandici meadow, destroyed white house, Kravica warehouse is further down, and to showing how the men were posted at that time in relation to Sandici meadow and destroyed white house. I know that Kravica warehouse is not very well visible here but is visible from the place where he took the pictures when we zoom in the picture we can see very easily Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. And again it's fairly self explanatory but you've marked an area with a white X. Can you just tell us what that is, how you came to pick that spot?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This spot was pointed to me by the member of the federal commission for the missing person as the place where the exhumation took place, exhumation of the people from Srebrenica, and exhumation was conducted in June 2004 by the federal commission. And I also saw the pictures and I believe video from this exhumation, and it was conducted exactly in this place behind the barrier down.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could continue playing, please, the video?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. That's good. If we go to pages 44 and 45 it's very difficult to stop exactly on it, you've got a man who flashes by the camera marked on pages 44 on photo A, and you've marked the location on page 45. Do you have anything to add to what's clear from your markings here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: When Petrovic passed the curve which is visible on the page 43, he stopped the car over there and from the -- while passing the curve, he recorded also the man which is depicted on the still from the page 44.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Probably this -- I am pretty sure that the two men depicted on page 20 -- 42, on still D, they are the men from page 44, still A, and the man from page 46, still A and B.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
