utterances.text: Okay. I see. Now, we stopped right at the man in still B on page 46. I think we can continue playing a little bit now until we get to the next man.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. So now we've seen the man who is in 46 A and B, he starts off shouting for people to come out of the hills and then we've seen the armed man on page 46 C. And on page 47, you've got two overviews where you've marked the locations of these men. Could you explain that, please, where we are?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are about 200 metres from Sandici meadow along the road Konjevic Polje-Bratunac, direction Konjevic Polje. We stopped -- actually the stills were taken from Petrovic with video which was recorded in this location, it was before the curve, before they reached the Sandici meadow again. And watching this video and comparing the features from the video, I mean the features of the terrain over there, from the video, and from life when I was there together with my colleague, I spotted the places where the two men depicted on the stills A, B and C were standing. And on the right side on the page 47, I just attached the first photo, the photo 1 is the overview of the area with the marks where these two guys were standing and also I pointed, I marked the location of destroyed white house and Sandici meadow. In the second picture, this is panorama picture, maybe it's not reflect exactly the shape of the road because here we see that the road is like cycling, and leading towards Konjevic Polje, but this is straight road with two bends on the left and on the right side because it was impossible to create a picture which could reflect the real stage.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. So just if I can lead for one point, I'll stop if I get an objection. It's that the photo on page 47, 2, the curve appears to be more pronounced than it is in reality because you created this panorama shot; is that right?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's right, it's too bent.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And I think now we can just continue, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. We are on pages 48 and 49. We have just seen a sequence where Mr. Petrovic has been outside the car filming men, Mr. Borovcanin and others, on the road. Can you tell us where we are here and whether we are closer or moving closer or not towards Sandici meadow and what we've called the destroyed white house?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: In this footage, in these stills from the Petrovic footage, we are getting closer to Sandici meadow. It's about 100, 150 metres from Sandici meadow. We see the people walking down from Sandici meadow towards Konjevic Polje. And also, I just located this place by comparing the stills we took from Petrovic footage and playing the footage itself on the spot. I compare the hills, the road and the features on the road and on the hills.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. I think we can keep playing now.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Sorry, on page 50 now, we've gone slightly past it but the men in photos A and B on page 50 who we see one crouching under the bush and one pointing his gun over the barrier, and we see on page 51 a barrier on a curve of the road heading towards the destroyed white house, can you just tell us a little bit how you were able to tell where these two men are?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I spotted this location, this location is located about 100 metres from Sandici meadow on the road Konjevic Polje-Bratunac, direction Konjevic Polje. And the men, the two men, they are standing behind a -- the barrier actually that is -- behind the barrier there is creek, also the creek is visible in the Petrovic video. I made the stills of the creek on the still C and I spotted this location, this is depicted on picture 1, picture 2, on the page 51, and picture 3, I made the picture, we made the picture of the creek below the road. And also the fourth picture, this is overview of the area with marked location of these men, and relation to this location to the location of Sandici meadow, destroyed white house and Kravica warehouse, and as I said again, before the Kravica warehouse it's not very well visible here on this picture but when you zoom in this picture on the computer, you could see the Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could continue just a little bit, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, at page 52, photo B, on the original footage it's not particularly clear right on that frame, but it's clear in the photo, Mr. Borovcanin speaking to a man wearing a blue helmet. Just again tell us how you know where we are? You've marked it on page 53.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: As before, I compared the location which I found with two men who were standing behind the barrier and pointing the guns towards the creek, and I see that Mr. Borovcanin is standing about 50 metres maybe or 30, 50, 30 metres from these men and it's also located on the road leading towards Kravica and Bratunac. And we can notice on the picture B that the car, from the page 52, that the car used by Mr. Borovcanin - we know that this car was used by Mr. Borovcanin from his statement and also from the statement of his driver - this car is heading towards direction of Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Well, there is -- looks like there is two cars in B which one are you referring to?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm referring to the grey-silver car.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Okay. We are now going to play some more segment and go, I think, straight through pages 54 and 55 and continue on through 56 and 57. And then I'll ask you to come back and explain these locations. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Now, let's go back to page 54 and 55, please. We've seen the men, we can see on page 54 just now on the video walking up, up a path, past some white pillars around the corner of a white building and we saw the man with the back-pack head down the -- and in the direction of the road there. Can you tell us what we've got depicted here and how you were able to determine where this sequence of the men walking out of the woods took place?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: From the recordings and from the still that we see that the recording was done in the destroyed white house located across the road from Sandici meadow. We see that the men were walking through the path leading from the north direction -- from the south direction towards the destroyed white house, passing the white house. And later on we can see that the people are passing the road towards Sandici meadow. The Sandici meadow is about 100 metres located from this destroyed white house here. We can compare the parts, poles of the house, we see very good the poles are visible on picture 2 on page 55 of the house. We can see from the recordings that the people are passing these poles.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, if we look at page 54, picture C, the man with the back-pack coming around a corner, you've marked his location on page 55 and picture 1 as a kind of the front corner of the white house heading down towards the Kravica-Konjevic Polje road. How did you determine that? Just that particular man's location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: I just followed the recording of Mr. Petrovic and I recognised the wall and the poles of the house depicted on picture 1 from page 55 and this is visible that the man is turning across the corner, behind the corner of this house, from the left -- from the left side of the house.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And on the still C, we can see part of the road and probably bus parked on the road and behind -- across this road there is Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. If we could now look at pages 56 and 57, very similar the way you've marked this on page 57, the location of the men and boys in photos A through E or A through F, excuse me, on page 56. I think your explanation is probably -- well, just, can you please tell me how you came to this conclusion, this sequence?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This explanation would be the same like the previous one. It's visible the poles of the house on the destroyed white house located across the road of -- from Sandici meadow and from -- from the recordings we can get more details of this house and also the path.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. And when were you there, did you walk up and down any of these paths or across the road to the meadow and recreate this path?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I did. I did it several times.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could continue, please, with some video?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Stop, sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: We saw one second of a photo of President Karadzic there. Do you know how -- do you have any explanation why that's on the tape?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's also recorded over on the original tape, but Mr. Petrovic I think he will explain by himself when he will testify in this Court.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And continue playing.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. We have just seen, we are at page 58 and photos A and B we see the man with the leather jacket who asks for water walking down a path and across the road and then the direction he's going is shown in photo C on page 58 and we see the back end of a parked bus. Can you just tell us where this man was walking in the clip we just saw?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This man used the same path which had been used by the previous men. He's walking along the white destroyed house located across the road from Sandici meadow. He's -- he's turning in the front of the house we see he's turning first right and left, crossing the road and going towards Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Could we continue, please, playing the video for a little while?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Can we stop? Sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now we are at counter 24.10.3, a couple of men in camouflage uniform sitting down by the road and one of them looks quickly away from the camera. Are these -- is the location of these men put in the book anywhere?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. I didn't put the location of these men on this road book because I wouldn't able to spot the place where they were sitting. I believe that this is in Sandici meadow, close to Sandici meadow, but I couldn't locate the place.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Continue.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I have some assumption but when I wasn't sure I didn't want to attach it to the book.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. We can stop there. That's the next section we see on the raw footage which we obtained from Mr. Petrovic, and that is the end of this chapter. What I'd like to do now, Your Honours, before we leave this section of the road is play the Studio B footage. We have a clip from the Kravica warehouse and we are at pages 60 and 61, excuse me, of the book now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: One moment, Mr. Nicholls. You said Studio B but this is what we see is Petrovic footage here as well. Is --

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: I can explain that, Your Honour. You're quite correct. This is the Studio B footage. It's taken from our trial video compilation. So that is a bit misleading. It's the Studio B broadcast segment which will be -- it will have the Studio B logo in the corner of the screen but you're correct it's been labelled this way because he is the one who took the film.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And now if we can play the slow motion of the same clip just so that -- to remind us of what the buildings look like.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we can look now at pages 60 and 61 in your book, Mr. Blaszczyk, you've got the two stills showing two parts of the Kravica warehouse from the Studio B footage on page 60 and you've made some photos and labels on page 61 of the Kravica warehouse. Can you explain to us these locations?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is Kravica warehouse, the warehouse is located in the village of Kravica. And on the page 60 I attached the stills from Studio B broadcast from edited material of Petrovic footage. This material, these stills, this clip, is not visible in the raw material, in the copied raw material we received from Mr. Petrovic. It was also recorded over somehow. And of course, the place is very known to everybody but I made a picture of this Kravica warehouse on the right -- on the page 61, I marked the location of the first still which was taken on the west door of Kravica warehouse and as on the page 1 and page -- sorry, on picture 1 from the page 61 and on picture 3 on the page 61 as the location A. And on the page -- on the page 61, on the picture 2 I marked the location where the bus is stopping on the still from Studio B broadcast, on still B from the page 60.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now -- and then just to give us an idea, how many times have you personally been to the Kravica warehouse location?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's many times. Difficult to say how many but every time when I'm in this area I'm passing this warehouse. It could be 50, 60 and more. And this warehouse was described by the witness Jean-Rene Ruez during his testimony in this trial in details.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. That's the end of chapter 2, Your Honours, that segment of the video we've covered. Mr. Blaszczyk has created a similar CD presentation for this area of chapter 2 which I'd like him to quickly run us through and show how it works and that's the last part that's on the CD. The rest of the book is not contained on the CD.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are again with presentation --

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Sorry, Mr. Blaszczyk, if you can, try to -- it will come up in a minute, try to quickly take us through in the same general order that you've got the -- as the video was taken as and as you've laid out the pictures in this chapter of the book.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, of course. We are entering the area --

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Sorry, it's not on our screens, yet. We'll have to -- okay. Now it's -- I think it's working now. Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We see the map of the area of Bratunac, Srebrenica, Kravica and Sandici. We are coming to the more detailed map of the area of Sandici. On this map, I marked the locations which were depicted on the stills from Petrovic video and located by me during my mission in this area. We link to the area of Sandici, from the recent picture. This is the link to the still from Petrovic, taken from Petrovic video. We can compare the house depicted on this still and the house from the recent picture. Also to help ourselves we can use the information button here to mark the link fields. We have the still from Petrovic video taken in July 1995, 13th of July 1995. Also, the still from Petrovic video above the -- on the hill we can see the small house over here.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And, excuse me, just to be clear, that's different from the -- that earlier damaged house which you showed us, that small -- you've labeled that one the small house, the earlier one you labelled the destroyed house which is closer to the meadow, correct?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, this is correct but this house, this small house, is also marked in my road book. We can see the same house on this picture. We can compare the area. We can get another view of the same area from another position. And the same area from the hill above the road leading towards Konjevic Polje. We see the white house across the road, destroyed white house across the road. On this still from Petrovic video we see part of the car. I recognised this car as the car used by Mr. Borovcanin and Petrovic. We see that the car is headed towards Konjevic Polje at this point. We see the aerial used by the radio from this car. Following the sequence from the Petrovic video, we can see that Mr. Petrovic is following the armed vehicles. The first footage with armed vehicles we located in -- it was recorded in Pervani area. We can link to the still from 1995. We can zoom in and we can see the hills in the background and also compare the road. From the recordings we see that armed vehicles moved towards Konjevic Polje, about 300 metres, the place is located by me. Also here we have the link from the picture to the still from the Petrovic video. And the first footage, on the way back, was recorded in this area. This is the house which is visible also on the still from Petrovic video. And the car in Petrovic is passing the wall in Lolici. I'm slowly moving this picture towards direction of Sandici and Bratunac. Here is the link to the still from Petrovic video. Here is the link to the second still from Petrovic video of the man standing and walking towards the wall. We are coming to the area quite close to the Sandici meadow. This is the links to the stills from Petrovic video depicted the men along the road and behind the barrier. This is the first man before we reaching the road. It's very hard to see this man on the recording but he's visible. We have two men crouching behind the barrier and watching towards south. The fourth man. And link to the Petrovic still and now I think we can see two men standing on the right side of the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Could we go back to that photo -- could we go back to the still that you just showed us the link? What's that on the dash board of the car, if you can see on the inside on the dash board?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is a hand set, Motorola hand set.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are slowly approaching the area of Sandici. I took Your Honours to the overview of this area. Here we have destroyed white house across the Sandici meadow, Sandici meadow itself. The previous picture a still from Petrovic video. And as we see from the recordings, Petrovic recordings, Petrovic got this point before the Sandici meadow, he stopped the car somewhere here and he recorded these two men. You can compare the curve of the road here, from the recording and from the still as well. We see two men also looking towards creek, to the south direction, and we see the red car and behind this red car we can see also the silver-grey car used by Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Petrovic. The area is located this about 100 metres, 150 metres, maybe 200 metres from the Sandici meadow. The Sandici meadow is on the left side of the road. We are getting -- we are in front of the destroyed white house right now and we can see the same area but from different perspective. We have more accurate picture of the car used by Mr. Borovcanin and Mr. Petrovic. We are going to the hill above the Sandici meadow, to see the landscape to see the overview of Sandici meadow, its surroundings.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Your Honours, I'm not sure if it's time. We could try to finish the presentation off quite quickly afterwards.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Unless there is a serious objection, we could try to finish this presentation. No, what I mean to say is this presentation that he is going through now. I know there are two other parts over there and those are not supported by -- so how long -- how much longer do you think you need to finish this presentation now?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Probably I would defer to Mr. Blaszczyk who knows it better than me but I would say 10 to 15 minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: No, no. Then we have the break. Then we have the break.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: The Kravica section takes a little bit more time and then it will be finished.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Then we will have the break now. Agreed?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: We'll have a 25-minute break now. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Go ahead, Mr. Nicholls.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Blaszczyk, if you could -- as quickly as you think you can, show us the remaining links for the Sandici meadow area and then we can move to the Kravica portion of your -- of your interactive CD. Before we do that, can you tell me, if you know which software was used to actually create the CD which we are looking at? I know we are playing it in QuickTime, but do you know which was used to make it?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: To be honest, not really because it was created with the help of video assistant, Mr. Zoran Lasic.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Thank you. We'll look into that. If you could just show us whichever remaining links we need to see and then we can move to Kravica.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay, we are going to the link with the view of the white house, the left side of the destroyed white house across the road from Sandici meadow. Here we see the poles of the white destroyed house. The same poles right here. And here we see the corner of this destroyed white house with the man with the back-pack passing this corner. I think we -- I think we have seen most of the probably everything from the Kravica -- from the Sandici meadow.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: That's fine. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And the next stop is Kravica warehouse. It's not visible on the copied raw material of Mr. Petrovic but this is brought -- it was broadcasted by Studio B in 1995, July 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: One question before you show us that. Just when we finished this section of the video, there was a shot of a rations box with a 1997 date on it. Can you tell us anything about why that is there in the video?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It was also recorded over by Mr. Petrovic somehow. I think he will explain the best how it was over-recorded.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And we are coming to Kravica. One in front of the Kravica warehouse. We see the west door of Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Just to be very clear, west door means heading towards -- that's the Sandici end?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, the west door is heading towards Sandici, the closest door to Sandici meadow. This is the road leading to Sandici and Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And while we are here, could you just do one spin around so that you could show Their Honours and my friends how we have the entire length of the warehouse and how close it is to the road.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, of course. On the left side of this screen we see the road now is heading towards Bratunac. It's visible from this point how close is the warehouse located in relation to the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. And what can you -- please continue.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: And we can link to the picture, to the still from Studio B broadcast.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Maybe could you show the button which shows us where all the fields are because that one is not marked well.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it this one is unfortunately not marked well. I can press the information button here. We see there are additional blue fields here. This is the links to the pictures, to the stills from Studio B broadcast. We see the west door of the warehouse in Kravica. We see the middle of Kravica warehouse and the bus. Also this is a still from Studio B broadcast. We can enter through the west door to Kravica warehouse, to the room in Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Now, this room, if you'll recall, we had two witnesses, PW-111 and PW-156, you've just entered the west door of the Sandici end. Was that the one that was identified by survivor 156 or 111, if you recall?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This room was identified by the survivor PW-156.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Can you just explain what we have here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just I went to another corner, to another end of the -- this room. And we are the same room but we look at this room from different perspective. And as witness, protected witness PW-156 described, he was located somewhere here.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: And you're indicating that rectangular area marked at the end corner of the building, we can see an outline?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, exactly, according to the witness in July 1995, it was a kind of booth, this corner.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: I apologise, maybe I should have intervened earlier but really I don't feel it's appropriate for this witness to comment on other witness's --

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Your Honour, if I may, the only intention is to provide Your Honours to link it up to the earlier testimony. It's pretty clear in the transcript just where we are in the house.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Then he could have restricted himself that this is relevant for the testimony of PW-whatever he is, and leave it at that.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Okay. We can see this room inside. We are leaving this room.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Before we leave it, if you can, you've been there several times, can you tell us, it's a bit difficult to gain a perspective as you're turning around, what are the approximate -- what are the dimensions, interior dimensions, of this Sandici-end room?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's about 260 square metres, and it had been measured first by the forensic team as far as I remember in September 1996 and also I confirmed by my measurement.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are going out from the white house, we are leaving this -- I'm so sorry, of course, from the warehouse, we are leaving this room. We are, again, in front of the west door. We are coming closer to the east part of warehouse in Kravica. We see -- this is east part of the Kravica warehouse. It was described by the Witness PW-111. We can see also the eastern corner of Kravica warehouse and backyard of the Kravica warehouse. They are the buildings attached to this complex of Kravica warehouse.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. If you could just finish spinning us around 360 here, we can get to that wooden -- that funny wooden structure there and the road again.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Behind the trees we have the road, now leading to Konjevic Polje -- Sandici-Konjevic Polje.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you very much. I think you've explained all the features of the CD presentation for that chapter.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I did. I would like to add that this is representation regarding only the first two chapters of this road book, and relating to 13 of July 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. If we can continue with the video now where we left off, Your Honours, it will go quicker now because it's less complicated. There aren't men along roads and curves to try to explain. It will go quite a bit quicker now.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. I think we probably recognise that building. We don't need to go back to it. Can you just tell us where we are now, which direction are we heading in and where are we?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are passing the DutchBat compound in Potocari. The car is driving towards direction of Srebrenica. And this is recording from 14 of July, 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. Please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could stop there at 26.11.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: This will continue but on the Studio B edited footage, what do we see at this point after we hear that music and passing the man leading the horse or the donkey?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: After this footage, we see the footage from the clips from Kravica warehouse with dead bodies in front of the Kravica warehouse. And yeah, this is visible that this footage was recorded on the 14th of July and that Kravica warehouse footage was recorded day before, on the 13th of July.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was edited at Studio B.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. If we can continue, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we could go back a couple frames? This is not in the books, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: But what's this building that we are passing on the right side at 27.16?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is building located in Srebrenica was used by UN, by DutchBat.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Again, just 27.32.5, what is this -- where are we here with this handwritten sign?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: We are on the street in Srebrenica. This is the police station in Srebrenica.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: In fact, it was -- this is the police station established by the Serbs.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. There aren't so many -- we haven't put so many photos in the still book here but this is on page 64 and 65, the big department store. Can you just tell us where this is in downtown Srebrenica?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is exactly in the centre of Srebrenica. I think this is the -- these two pictures are -- these two buildings are the most recognisable buildings in the town. Is department store Srebrenicanka and municipality building on the right side of this picture. And recorded -- the recording which we have seen right now was done on this street leading to the Srebrenicanka department store from direction of Potocari.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you. We can continue with the video.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: If we can go back to the scene of these men walking up the street from behind?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: It's difficult to see here on this video still playing it in Sanction, but the patch on the left arm of the man in the middle, have you been able to tell what patch that is, what that signifies?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I've seen better quality picture still from this video and this is the patch of the Drina Wolves unit.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Continue, please. Sorry, I should have said for the record we were at approximately 39.41. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: It's playing a little bit choppy at the moment but we can stop here at 41.12.5 just for Your Honours to know, here we are the date and time stamp showing the 14th of July. We can continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: All right. Mr. Blaszczyk we've now -- you could say we have left Srebrenica and come to Zeleni Jadar wood factory, chapter 4 of your book. Could you just -- and this is shown mostly on pages 70 and 71, the photos showing the location and we'll watch this clip in a minute. I think it's quite clear from your video still you've selected and the current photograph on page 71, looking at photo A on page 70 and photo A on page 71. Can you just tell us where we are and what we see here?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we are in Zeleni Jadar wood factory on the page 70 on the stills A, we see the building, wood factory in Zeleni Jadar. On the page 71, we see the current picture of the same building. And on the page B from the sequences when we play the footage, we see that the people are working inside the factory.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Okay. I think you could say that in 70 B, who are the people in that photo?

utterances.speaker: TOMASZ BLASZCZYK [Resumed]
utterances.text: In the first man in front of us, from -- this is Tomo Kovac, the former Minister of Interior of Republika Srpska. The second man in the middle is Dragomir Vasic and the last one is Mr. Borovcanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Play the video now, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, one moment.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: I apologise, first I would like to see whether Mr. Nicholls would finish with his testimony today because there is one issue that I would like to raise before the Trial Chamber. It would take literally two minutes just to make sure that I'm going to have them.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: We have about five minutes left.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Your Honour, there is approximately 20 minutes, a little bit less than 20 minutes of video left which won't require too much intervention by me but I think it's important to see it before Mr. Petrovic comes. So, no, we won't finish today but we'll finish quite quickly tomorrow afternoon.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So why don't we stop here and we'll start the wood factory tomorrow again.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: That's a good idea. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I think so. Okay, Mr. Blaszczyk, we haven't finished yet. We'll continue tomorrow in the afternoon at 2.15. And, hopefully, then we should finish with you, with cross-examinations too.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Lazarevic?

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, I believe I'll have to wait, and allow Mr. Blaszczyk to leave the courtroom.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Mr. Blaszczyk was testifying today in the capacity of the witness. He made a solemn declaration. He didn't finish with his testimony today. We are aware of the situation that Mr. Petrovic is right here in The Hague, and it appears that Mr. Blaszczyk was also present when Mr. Petrovic was giving his interview to the Office of the Prosecution. So, I would just like to raise this issue before the Trial Chamber because we would vigorously oppose to a situation that Mr. Blaszczyk and Mr. Petrovic meet before Mr. Petrovic finishes his testimony. I'm fully aware that this particular witness is chief investigator in the Prosecution, but right now he's a witness before the Tribunal so he should be prevented of discussing the gist of his testimony with another witness. Just I would like to raise this for the Trial Chamber.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Lazarevic. Who is going to deal with this? Yes, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Could we have one moment, Your Honour?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, certainly.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours, for that moment. I can understand in principle what my friend is saying. Our strong preference, I have not yet met Mr. Petrovic since he's arrived here, would be to meet with him with Mr. Tomasz Blaszczyk, as the investigator. Mr. Blaszczyk was involved in the interview with Mr. Petrovic and knows him and the Court is aware that we had some difficulty or was not easy at the beginning getting Mr. Petrovic to agree to come here and I think it could be helpful. I don't really see what the problem is. Of course, the testimony of both witnesses is related since it covers the same video. However, Mr. Blaszczyk has testified to is very straightforward. We would not be discussing his testimony at all between myself and Mr. Blaszczyk or Mr. Petrovic. He would simply assist me as investigator does in the proofing. I think especially the nature of this type of testimony, where he is just talking about places he's identified in the video and where he's been is not -- I don't see any risk of corruption of these two meeting, and I would much prefer that Mr. Blaszczyk be available for the proofing this afternoon. It's not -- I just don't see the problem.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: And also take an active part? In other words? Because the proofing will be done by you, presumably --

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: It is by me. He might ask questions. He probably doesn't need to, really, but he would --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: But can he follow the proofing without being present in the same room?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes, but it's more that I think it will -- it's more his presence that I want. I need a -- I always have a witness with me whenever I talk to anybody, and he knows the witness, Mr. Petrovic, who is coming and they have -- as I said he's been to his home and all of that and I think it would be helpful to me, and I just can't imagine where the problem is going to be. Any cross-examination is still to come and anything can be asked about what's talked about but we won't be discussing Mr. Blaszczyk's testimony at all during that proofing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Mr. Lazarevic, do you wish to comment further?

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I believe we were all very carefully listening to what Mr. Blaszczyk said. He made quite a lot of comments, his own comments, about certain parts of this video and, basically, I think that same rule should apply to any witness, whether it's an investigator of the OTP or any other witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Basically they are discussing the same events.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. We are all in agreement here on how it should go. Judge Prost will be explaining to you exactly how you will be proceeding during the proofing session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PROST
utterances.text: Taking into account the submissions that were made and the Prosecution's point relating to the relationship such as it may be between Mr. Blaszczyk and the -- Mr. Petrovic, we would prefer if Mr. Blaszczyk is present only at the commencement of the interview to greet the witness, to have any preliminary non-substantive discussions and then he leaves when the actual substantive proofing session takes place for the remainder of that process.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: In addition, I would add that if at any time during the proofing session you need to consult Mr. Blaszczyk, you can, of course, interrupt the proofing and go and consult Mr. Blaszczyk.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. That's the end for today. Could you convey our apologies to -- all right. Okay. Yes, Mr. Lazarevic?

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Well, Your Honours, I really cannot say anything. We are fine with Your Honour's ruling, just to make sure that it's all done in proper way, I believe it should be maybe recorded.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. We stand adjourned until tomorrow at 2.15.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 4th day of December, 2007, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.50 p.m.,
